name: comparison
description: Three-column comparison: value pillars, an elevated Asset Panda column under a panda banner and a muted old-way column; one stacked card below 1280px. Live: #ap-asset-intel-compare-v1 on the homepage (--home) and the Asset Intelligence Platform page (--platform), markup and sheets ported.

variant.description: Which sheet the section follows: home (live homepage, CTA row under the table), platform (live Asset Intelligence Platform page, Connected-by-design card under it) or guide (the comparison guides: any number of rows, an optional winner pill under each criterion, an optional footnote).

title.description: Heading, one line per row of text (line breaks split the lines).

title_accent.description: The heading line painted with the brand gradient; must equal one of the title's lines.

table_label.description: Accessible name of the table (defaults to the heading).

after_title.description: Heading of the highlighted centre column. UrsaAI is styled as the brand mark.

before_title.description: Heading of the muted right column.

vs_label.description: Text after the centre heading on the stacked layout (live: " vs. Spreadsheets & Siloed Tools"). Defaults to " vs. " + before_title.

rows.description: Rows. Each: pillar, after and before, all required; optional winner (guide variant: the pill under the criterion, e.g. Asset Panda, EZO, Tie — a name containing Asset Panda is drawn green, Tie grey, anything else indigo). UrsaAI in after is styled as the brand mark.

winner_title.description: Guide variant: the small label inside each winner pill (not shown on a Tie).

note.description: Footnote under the table, e.g. the meaning of an asterisk in a winner cell.

banner.description: Panda banner image at the top of the centre column (live Frame-5-crisp.png).

cta_label.description: Button under the centre column (home). Renders only with cta_url.

link_label.description: Text link beside the button. Renders only with link_url.

connected_title.description: Card under the table (platform): heading, e.g. Connected by design.
